Actual200% observed only on admin overview; all other pages/roles/actions at200% and remaining scenario variants remain future acceptance, not PASS. Provider reconciliation not performed. Owner excluded VoiceOver, not tested/PASS. IA, priorities, free-to-wallet and core subscription policy approved. No implementation or release.

owner_decisions.ia_and_priority: Explicitly approved by owner: user balance/history/cost, settings separate; admin money/operations/customers, settings separate; money safety first, then explanation/accessibility, then compactness.
owner_decisions.free_to_wallet: Approved: automatically continue with wallet funds after free quota exhaustion, with a visible contextual notice, not an extra confirmation. Scope-specific insufficient remainder vs exhausted quota vs non-free model distinguished.
owner_decisions.subscription_policy: Explicitly approved by owner: preserve current paid term and consumed usage; downgrade from next term; separate extension and compensation. Requirements only, not production financial implementation or blanket approval of a new proration formula.
owner_decisions.voiceover: Owner explicitly requested not to test VoiceOver. Not enabled, not verified, excluded from current live acceptance rather than marked PASS. Source-based accessibility findings remain.
owner_decisions.browser_zoom: Owner explicitly confirmed actual200% enabled. Admin overview readability/selected keyboard actions observed at313x475/DPR4; navigation reset zoom627x951/DPR2. Other pages/roles at200% unverified. Earlier failed emulation not retroactively counted.
